decisions.reason: Locked label is right. cp 2068 is a citation template ({{استشهاد بهارفارد دون أقواس}}, a 'استشهاد …' name, which 3.1 lists) inside the body of the ref at cp 2063 (d4), so it belongs in d4.templates as locked. In the render it appears as inline text '(Hutton 2010، صفحة 247)' in footnote cite_note-4, with no footnote of its own. Ambiguity: section 2 lists harvnb-style templates as short footnotes only when they generate a footnote; these do not, because they sit inside another ref's body. 'template_unit_missed' is not one of the guide's listed item kinds; I decided on the location as the template entry the guide asks for.

Locked template entry is right: the template is a citation template (name starts with 'استشهاد' or is 'Harvard citation') inside the body of ref d4 (<ref> at cp 2063, </ref> at cp 3273), so 3.1 lists it under d4.templates. It is not a separate footnote (see item 0). cp 2199 is {{Harvard citation|Scarre|Callow|2001|pp=1, 21}}; the name contains 'Citation', which 3.1 lists.
